rubrics.question: Does every submitted fragment receive a stable, public-safe intake record and explicit disposition?
Has each promoted source been closely read into support, non-support, review, preservation, and provenance fields?
Are claims small and precise enough that their evidence relationship, qualification, and correction history can be evaluated?
Does every mature claim resolve to known sources, projects, inquiries, and public-safe evidence relationships?
Are knowledge maturity, publication safety, and editorial selection represented independently?
Can fragments and claims be situated in projects, entities, timelines, related work, and future photo research?
Are unresolved memories, dead links, negative findings, methods, and limitations preserved without becoming facts?
Does the public site select only mature, safe, purposeful claims while leaving the rest available in the bank?
